problem_statement: NuttX lacks a kernel event group primitive. PR #12802 adds a new event API (nxevent_init, nxevent_post, nxevent_wait, nxevent_reset, nxevent_destroy) declared in include/nuttx/event.h and implemented in sched/event/. The feature is gated behind CONFIG_SCHED_EVENTS=y. Apps PR #2458 adds nxevent.c to ostest which exercises this new API. On the base kernel commit, event.h does not exist, so nxevent.c fails to compile.
